report.summary: Food needs assessment for P-D010 (visit V-D010). Screener dated 2026-10-21 shows no current food insecurity (food_worry and food_ran_out both "never_true"). Community food resources identified from the clinic directory: Northwest Side Food Pantry (Mon/Wed/Fri 12-3 PM, no ID required), Madison Street Community Fridge (daily 8 AM-8 PM, take-what-you-need), and Saturday Market Pantry (Saturdays 9 AM-noon, Cook County residents only). Patient's home tract 17031100500 is in Cook County, suggesting eligibility for the Saturday pantry. A pantry pre-registration form is available to check qualification (requires name, DOB, address, household size).
